title: Next Advice v1
description: The agent's next-step recommendation for one project state: which candidate command to run, how to phrase it, and why. Candidates are supplied by the deterministic gap ladder — the agent re-ranks and rephrases, it never invents commands; the command is validated against that candidate list on every read. The artifact is keyed to the assessment's contextHash, so a stale report or an absent model falls back to the ladder and `next` always answers.

command.description: Exactly one of the candidate commands the gap ladder supplied, copied verbatim.

suggestion.description: One sentence telling the user what to do and what it unlocks, redacted of secret shapes before display.

rationale.description: One sentence justifying why this candidate beats the others right now, redacted of secret shapes.
